subject.title: Feature Request: Per-model usage logging for cost tracking

question: Should per-call usage accounting be a canonical core SQLite ledger, or a plugin-owned capability built on supported model, cron, and subagent event hooks?
rationale: Existing summaries and event hooks cover much of the data, but they do not decide persistent-state ownership, privacy, event identity, retention, backfill, or whether core readers should depend on a ledger.

options.title: Plugin-Owned Accounting
options.body: Confirm and document the supported event contract, add only genuinely missing attribution fields, and publish durable accounting, alerts, and dashboards as plugins.

options.title: Core SQLite Ledger
options.body: Approve a canonical privacy-minimized usage table with idempotent event identity, retention, backfill, scoped queries, and shared CLI/UI readers.

options.title: Keep Summaries Only
options.body: Retain transcript-backed summaries and diagnostic telemetry without promising durable per-call accounting.

recommendation.title: Plugin-Owned Accounting
recommendation.body: Confirm and document the supported event contract, add only genuinely missing attribution fields, and publish durable accounting, alerts, and dashboards as plugins.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is most directly connected to the current usage-cost implementation and already supplied item-specific guidance about the unresolved product boundary.
